## Production Experience
### Groww You — Full Stack Developer Intern (June 2026 – August 2026)
- **Multi-Tenant ERP Platform**: Architected unified schemas for inventory, branch separation, and double-entry bookkeeping across Web (Next.js) and Mobile (React Native / Expo). Implemented automated GST/E-Way billing and dual-format (A4 and POS thermal) receipt generation.
- **Token-Refresh Concurrency Engine**: Root-caused repeated session logout defects in a live ride-hailing app under heavy concurrency. Engineered a unified refresh engine with mutex request locking, pending queue buffering, and zero dropped trips.
- **Offline Sync & CI/CD**: Built an OTA-safe pure-JavaScript UUID generator and dual-trigger retry synchronization logic for offline warehouse workers. Established the repository's first CI/CD quality gates using Husky and GitHub Actions.
- **Broadcast & Real-Time Alerts**: Shipped an administrative dashboard notification engine supporting geo-targeted announcements for active riders and drivers.
- **Home-Services Booking Engine**: Built complete instant and scheduled appointment booking flows with ratings, FCM push notifications, and wallet ledger payouts.

## Featured Architectures & Projects
### 1. SEO Health Scanner
- **Overview**: Full-stack asynchronous web performance audit engine evaluating Core Web Vitals via Google Lighthouse API, backed by BullMQ workers, Redis caching, and Gemini AI actionable remediation reporting.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), NestJS (TypeScript), Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, BullMQ, Redis, Google Lighthouse API, Google Gemini AI.
- **Key Metric**: Sub-second cached audit responses (down from ~25s) with zero event-loop starvation.

### 2. AI-Powered Legal Risk Analyzer
- **Overview**: NLP document analyzer featuring a custom semantic chunking algorithm bypassing the 512-token transformer limit to perform zero-shot risk classification, named entity recognition (NER), and contractual liability scoring across 50+ page legal documents.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Hugging Face Transformers (BART-Large-MNLI, BERT-NER), Zero-Shot Classification, PyPDF.
- **Key Metric**: 100% clause coverage bypassing 512-token truncation on 50+ page contracts without model retraining.
